spans.text: Unu womanu loku sumbila omuenyo wapata omanu vosi kilu lieve, olio esilã liovihandeleko li nena eyovo, esunga kuenda ombembua voluali

entries.object: oku pembula ovihandeleko vitata omuenyo womanu ku tuala omanu ko kulinga uvî kuenje uvî waco wa nena onyeño vovitima viomanu vosi

spans.text: Ekambo liu kulihiso kuenda oku pembula ovihandeleko vitata omuenyo womanu ku tuala omanu ko kulinga uvî kuenje uvî waco wa nena onyeño vovitima viomanu vosi, yu va sanga ocisimilo calonga cokuti omunu lomunu okuete omoko lutoyi woku tava pamue okupatalã eci cosi ayongola pamue kayongola kuenda ka kuata usumba woku talisua ohali.

entries.subject: pamue kayongola
entries.object: ka kuata usumba woku talisua ohali

entries.task_id: ko hongele|yolofeka|(nações unidas) lia kapiwa kovihandeleko vikola vioku tata omuenyo womanu
entries.description: ko Hongele yolofeka (Nações Unidas) lia kapiwa kovihandeleko vikola vioku tata omuenyo womanu
entries.subject: ko Hongele
entries.object: (Nações Unidas) lia kapiwa kovihandeleko vikola vioku tata omuenyo womanu

spans.text: Ekolelõ liomanu vosi va tiamela ko Hongele Yolofeka (Nações Unidas) lia kapiwa kovihandeleko vikola vioku tata omuenyo womanu, yu vaci pitulula vali vukanda owu okuti, esumbilo kuenda unene womunu vi tunda koku kapa omanu vosi pomangu yimosi- okuti vosi vasoka kunene - nda ulume nda ukayî kuenda loku vahã cimosi civa kuatisa okuama kovaso loku kuata eyovo liocili.
Olofeka viosi vi tiamelã ko Hongele Yolofeka (Nações Unidas) kuenda ombonge yavo, vali kunda okuti esumbilo voluali kuenda esumbilo lomuenyo womanu te viamoleha kovilinga, oco eyovo liocili.

entries.task_id: eyovo liocili|kuenda|esanju lia suapo liomanu
entries.description: eyovo liocili kuenda esanju lia suapo liomanu
entries.subject: eyovo liocili
entries.object: esanju lia suapo liomanu

spans.text: Kovisila evi vioku tata omuenyo womanu oko ku tunda eyovo liocili kuenda esanju lia suapo liomanu.

entries.task_id: ohuminyo|eyi|yoku tata omuenyo womanu
entries.description: Ohuminyo eyi yoku tata omuenyo womanu
entries.subject: Ohuminyo
entries.object: yoku tata omuenyo womanu

spans.text: Ohuminyo eyi yoku tata omuenyo womanu, voluali luosi oko kocimaho oluali lua sesamela oku loña, apata osi , olofeka viosi, oco okuti omanu vosi kuenda olombonge viosi violohongele viomanu vavi kapa vovitima viavo kuenje ohuminyo yaco yendelela kuvosi okuti okulisumbila pokati oco eyovo lienda kovaso, nda pokati komanu vakuafeka yimosi nda pokati kolofeka vioposamua vatiamela vo Hongele yolofeka va tava ovihandeleko evi.

entries.object: unu umosi

spans.text: Omanu vosi kilu lieve va citiwa lonjila yimosi leyovo limosi, lomoko yimosi kuenda unu umosi, kuenje momo vosi va kuete olondunge, va sesamela okulisumbila pokati ndavamanji.

entries.description: lisanja vofeka kuenda yoku hindingila
entries.subject: lisanja vofeka
entries.object: yoku hindingila

spans.text: Omunu wosi okuete omoko yoku kuata omuenyo wahe, yoku lisanja vofeka kuenda yoku hindingila.

entries.task_id: kala olonepele|kuenda|osombisiwa kombonge yolonganji kavi tiamela kusoma laumue
entries.description: kala olonepele kuenda osombisiwa kombonge yolonganji kavi tiamela kusoma laumue
entries.subject: kala olonepele
entries.object: osombisiwa kombonge yolonganji kavi tiamela kusoma laumue

spans.text: Omunu wosi okuete omoko yoku sombisiwa lesunga lolonganji, okuti kapa kala olonepele kuenda osombisiwa kombonge yolonganji kavi tiamela kusoma laumue, kuenje va sisa ciwa eko liaco.

entries.task_id: mekonda lieko|lia|lingiwa konyima yoloneke eci okuti eko liaco halia kolele ndeci ca sonehiwa vovihandaleko violonganji
entries.description: mekonda lieko lia lingiwa konyima yoloneke eci okuti eko liaco halia kolele ndeci ca sonehiwa vovihandaleko violonganji
entries.subject: mekonda lieko
entries.object: lingiwa konyima yoloneke eci okuti eko liaco halia kolele ndeci ca sonehiwa vovihandaleko violonganji

spans.text: Lomue olinga ocikonde mekonda lieko lia lingiwa konyima yoloneke eci okuti eko liaco halia kolele ndeci ca sonehiwa vovihandaleko violonganji, nda vio feka nda violo feka vioposamua.

entries.description: ocihandeleko cavelapo kuenda ocisila coluali
entries.subject: ocihandeleko cavelapo
entries.object: ocisila coluali

spans.text: Epata olio ocihandeleko cavelapo kuenda ocisila coluali, cisukiliwa pokati kolohongele viomanu, yu epata lia sesamela okutatiwa lolombiali viofeka.

entries.task_id: yu epata|lia|sesamela okutatiwa lolombiali viofeka
entries.description: yu epata lia sesamela okutatiwa lolombiali viofeka
entries.subject: yu epata
entries.object: sesamela okutatiwa lolombiali viofeka

entries.task_id: ketavo ayongola|kuenda|omoko yaco yu wiha evelo lioku pongolokela ketavo likuavo pamue oku lekisa kuvakuavo etavo liahe
entries.description: ketavo ayongola kuenda omoko yaco yu wiha evelo lioku pongolokela ketavo likuavo pamue oku lekisa kuvakuavo etavo liahe
entries.subject: ketavo ayongola
entries.object: omoko yaco yu wiha evelo lioku pongolokela ketavo likuavo pamue oku lekisa kuvakuavo etavo liahe

spans.text: Omunu eye omunu walisanja oku sima eci apanga ndeci etavo; okuete omoko yoku kala ketavo ayongola kuenda omoko yaco yu wiha evelo lioku pongolokela ketavo likuavo pamue oku lekisa kuvakuavo etavo liahe, nda lika wahe nda ocisoko comanu, nda posamua nda pulika.

entries.task_id: lokuvi vangula|kuenda|lomue u usakalasa mekonda liaco
entries.description: lokuvi vangula kuenda lomue u usakalasa mekonda liaco
entries.subject: lokuvi vangula
entries.object: lomue u usakalasa mekonda liaco

spans.text: Omunu eye omunu okuete omoko yoku yo kueca ovisimilo viahe, lokuvi vangula kuenda lomue u usakalasa mekonda liaco, kuenda citava okusandula ovisimilo viahe vofeka pamue posamua, vovingungu viosi vioku popela.

entries.description: lava kuavo kuenda oku tunga ohongele cinene ño nda ohongele yaco yombembua

entries.object: oku tunga ohongele cinene ño nda ohongele yaco yombembua

spans.text: Omunu eye omunu okuete omoko yoku likongela lava kuavo kuenda oku tunga ohongele cinene ño nda ohongele yaco yombembua.

entries.description: likongela kohongele eyi kayongola
entries.subject: likongela kohongele
entries.object: kayongola

spans.text: Lomue kaka kisikiwe oku likongela kohongele eyi kayongola.

entries.task_id: cilingiwa lesunga|kuenda|ocilli
entries.description: cilingiwa lesunga kuenda ocilli
entries.subject: cilingiwa lesunga
entries.object: ocilli

spans.text: Onjongole yomanu oyo ongusu yusoma wofeka; kuenje casesamela okunola asongui locela cilingiwa lesunga kuenda ocilli.

entries.task_id: ha lolonepeleko|kuenda|omunu lomunu osoneha onduko asima pokañunuñunu
entries.description: ha lolonepeleko kuenda omunu lomunu osoneha onduko asima pokañunuñunu
entries.subject: ha lolonepeleko
entries.object: omunu lomunu osoneha onduko asima pokañunuñunu

spans.text: Ocela caco cikuame ocihandeleko coluali, okuti ha lolonepeleko kuenda omunu lomunu osoneha onduko asima pokañunuñunu.

entries.task_id: nda elongiso|kuenda|tu panduila olombonge vio feka kuenda olombonge vioposamua ekuatiso vasole okueca
entries.description: nda elongiso kuenda tu panduila olombonge vio feka kuenda olombonge vioposamua ekuatiso vasole okueca
entries.subject: nda elongiso
entries.object: tu panduila olombonge vio feka kuenda olombonge vioposamua ekuatiso vasole okueca

spans.text: Omunu eye omunu wa sesamela oku tatiwa lombonge yitukuiwa "Segurança Social" yofeka a tiamela, kuenda citava oku kisika ombonge yaco ekuatiso nda lio tupalata, nda elongiso kuenda tu panduila olombonge vio feka kuenda olombonge vioposamua ekuatiso vasole okueca.

entries.task_id: eci ayongola|kuenda|omunu wosi ovindikiyiwa kocitangi cekambo liupange
entries.description: eci ayongola kuenda omunu wosi ovindikiyiwa kocitangi cekambo liupange
entries.subject: eci ayongola
entries.object: omunu wosi ovindikiyiwa kocitangi cekambo liupange

spans.text: Omunu wosi okeute omoko yoku kuata upange, yoku nolã upange u usanjuisa loku umuisa eci ayongola kuenda omunu wosi ovindikiyiwa kocitangi cekambo liupange.

spans.text: Epata olio ocihandeleko cavelapo kuenda ocisila coluali, cisukiliwa pokati kolohongele viomanu, yu epata lia sesamela okutatiwa lolombiali viofeka.

folded.id: ohuminyo|eyi|yoku tata omuenyo womanu
folded.subject: Ohuminyo
folded.object: yoku tata omuenyo womanu

spans.text: Ohuminyo eyi yoku tata omuenyo womanu, voluali luosi oko kocimaho oluali lua sesamela oku loña, apata osi , olofeka viosi, oco okuti omanu vosi kuenda olombonge viosi violohongele viomanu vavi kapa vovitima viavo kuenje ohuminyo yaco yendelela kuvosi okuti okulisumbila pokati oco eyovo lienda kovaso, nda pokati komanu vakuafeka yimosi nda pokati kolofeka vioposamua vatiamela vo Hongele yolofeka va tava ovihandeleko evi.

spans.text: Ekambo liu kulihiso kuenda oku pembula ovihandeleko vitata omuenyo womanu ku tuala omanu ko kulinga uvî kuenje uvî waco wa nena onyeño vovitima viomanu vosi, yu va sanga ocisimilo calonga cokuti omunu lomunu okuete omoko lutoyi woku tava pamue okupatalã eci cosi ayongola pamue kayongola kuenda ka kuata usumba woku talisua ohali.
